# Oldest runtime-dependency versions that pyproject.toml claims to support.
# Used by the CI `minimum-versions` job (via PIP_CONSTRAINT) to keep the
# declared floors honest.  Dev tools (pytest/ruff/mypy) are deliberately left
# floating; only runtime dependencies are pinned here.
#
# numpy 2.0 is required (the code uses numpy.trapezoid); scipy 1.13 and
# pandas 2.2.2 are the first releases compatible with the numpy 2 ABI, and
# matplotlib 3.9 the first plot line tested against it.
numpy==2.0.2
scipy==1.13.1
pandas==2.2.2
click==8.1.8
matplotlib==3.9.4
